Allow VLC Plus to install apps in Android settings, then tap Check for VLC Plus updates again.
Experimental: subtitles can be selected during casting, but the receiver may not display them yet.

If a video plays without sound on your TV, turn Audio Passthrough OFF to let VLC convert the audio. Keep Audio only OFF to cast video too. If sound is still missing, the audio codec may need additional conversion support.
